templates.description: Self-hosted platform of autonomous, persistent personal AI agents that collaborate, remember, and build their own tools. Reachable via Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, Signal and Matrix. Single container with Bun and SQLite, no external infrastructure. Source: https://github.com/MarlBurroW/hivekeep

env.label: Bind address — keep 0.0.0.0 so the port mapping is reachable
env.name: HOST

env.label: External URL for links and webhooks
env.name: PUBLIC_URL

templates.name: hivekeep
templates.note: LLM provider keys are added in-app after first-run onboarding, not via environment. If the app is unreachable after deploy, ensure HOST=0.0.0.0.
templates.title: Hivekeep

templates.description: Self-hostable AI config management platform for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, and 30+ AI assistant formats. Source: https://github.com/GeiserX/LynxPrompt

env.description: The https:// address of your reverse proxy, such as https://lynxprompt.example.com. Sign-in does not work over plain http.
env.label: Public HTTPS address (required)
env.name: APP_URL

env.description: Sign-in is a link sent by mail
env.label: SMTP server (required)
env.name: SMTP_HOST

env.description: From address of the sign-in mails
env.label: Sender address (required)
env.name: SMTP_FROM

env.description: Leave empty if the server needs no login
env.label: SMTP user
env.name: SMTP_USER

env.description: This address becomes super-admin on its second sign-in
env.label: Super-admin email
env.name: SUPERADMIN_EMAIL

templates.name: lynxprompt
templates.note: Sign-in is a link sent by mail, so fill in the SMTP fields. Put the stack behind an HTTPS reverse proxy and set APP_URL to that address: browsers refuse the sign-in cookies on plain http, localhost included. Generate the secrets with openssl rand -hex 32 and openssl rand -hex 24. All options: https://github.com/GeiserX/LynxPrompt/blob/main/env.example
templates.title: LynxPrompt
